Shooting Speed
I have been waiting three days for this. I have to go to this court mandated outpatient rehab program once a week, with random testing. Thank God I waited cuz this time I had to test. A couple of times I have gone in dirty or high, because I just couldn't stop. Waiting kind of makes it that much better anyway.
I draw up 10cc's of water and drop a rock into the spoon. I squirt the water onto the rock, and crush it up with the other end of the point. It completely dissolves, not a grain of sand at the bottom of the spoon, meaning very pure. Drop in a cotton and draw it all up, making sure not to waste a drop, and carefully avoiding scraping the spoon with the point.There is a little more than 40 cc's so I know I'm doing 30 cents. Medium size shot, but really good dope.  I tie off, find a suitable vein, and slide the point into my arm.
The second best part is when I see the little cloud of blood explode into the barrel of the point. Pretty as the prettiest flower and it means I am IN! I pull back the plunger, drawing more blood into the barrel, untie, and push it all back in. I feel my panties get wet, my body feels warm and tingly all over, all the hairs on my body stand at attention, and the taste in the back of my throat is so strong it makes me cough. Awesome! Nothing better than this!
